statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of atrial fibrillation
The patient has a history of prior transient ischemic attacks
Diagnosis codes I49.9 and I48.91 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
Continuous monitoring is required to characterize the arrhythmia burden and assess for potential thromboembolic risk
The cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is medically necessary to support the diagnosis of I49.9 and I48.91
